verdict.rationale: LiveKit is a WebRTC SFU, so simulcast/layered publishing with per-subscriber bandwidth adaptation is a fair axis. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents simulcast, SVC, or adaptive layer selection. Community items only call it an SFU built on Pion, which does not evidence this capability.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, publishers send layered or simulcast video and the service adapts the layer each subscriber receives to their bandwidth
